text: Program Description Anthropotomy and Histo-embryologyis a science that studies the relationship between the morphology, structure, position, proximity, structure and function of various parts of the normal human body. Gross anatomy is the science of observing the shape and structure of human organs and systems with the naked eye by cutting bodies with anatomical instruments. Microanatomy can be divided into cytology and histology. The microscopic anatomy of the human body must be studied by the magnification of optical microscope or electron microscope. Duration 3 years
